about.heading: Fountainhead Preschool Vesu
about.intro: Fountainhead Preschool Vesu (FPV) is the Fountainhead early years experience for families in the Vesu area of Surat. Backed by the same IB PYP philosophy and the Fountainhead learning model, FPV creates a warm, safe, and intellectually stimulating space for children aged 3–6. At FPV, children are not just cared for — they are inspired. Every day is an inquiry. Every moment is an opportunity to grow, explore, and discover who they are and how the world around them works. Previously The Village Early Learning Centre.

learningPillars.title: Learner Agency
learningPillars.body: Every child at FPV has genuine choice, voice, and ownership of their learning journey — from the very beginning.

learningPillars.title: Inquiry Through Play
learningPillars.body: Play is learning. Every activity at FPV is designed to provoke curiosity, encourage exploration, and develop critical thinking.

learningPillars.title: Social-Emotional Resilience
learningPillars.body: We develop emotional vocabulary and the resilience children need to navigate their world with confidence and care.

learningPillars.title: Environment as Third Teacher
learningPillars.body: FPV spaces are intentionally designed — with materials that invite exploration and displays that reflect children's thinking.

academics.learningModelText1: Inquiry-based, play-led, IB PYP-aligned early childhood education. Developing curious, caring, and courageous young learners through six transdisciplinary themes.
academics.learningModelText2: FPV classrooms are carefully prepared environments — with natural light, inviting learning corners, and materials that prompt exploration. Every inch of the space is designed with the child in mind.
